page.overview:
Who is Knights Templar?

The Knights Templar, also known as the templarate, is an organization in Final Fantasy Tactics. It is a knightly order, led by Folmarv Tengille, that serves as an armed branch of the Church of Glabados, and the personal army of High Confessor Marcel.

Many of the Knights Templar under Folmarv were under the control of, or in league with, the Lucavi demons. Others were unaware that they served the Lucavi. When Ramza Beoulve was declared a heretic after stumbling onto the Lucavi plot, the Knights Templar did everything in their power to keep Ramza from interfering in their plan.

Folmarv led a quest to revive Ultima, the leader of the Lucavi. As the right hand man of High Confessor Marcel, he sought the Zodiac Stones and to achieve enough bloodshed required for a ritual to revive her. This would involve engineering the War of the Lions, to shed enough blood, and keep Ivalice preoccupied while the templarate sought the Stones.

The true nature of Folmarv's plot was unbeknownst to most of the Church. Instead, they were led to believe the Stones were being sought to bring back the Zodiac Braves, a known legend in Church of Glabados mythos, while growing the Church's military power. The war was thought to be engineered to weaken two political factions in Ivalice so the Church could seize power by offering peace on their terms. It was framed as a noble goal as the Church of Glabados would reunify the land and create a classless society. Many of Folmarv's followers believed him to be the second coming of Saint Ajora. High Confessor Marcel was unaware of this plot, as were many high-ranking Knights Templar, including Folmarv's own children—Isilud and Meliadoul—and Folmarv's right hand men—Loffrey Wodring and Cletienne Duroi. Other high-ranking officials who had already been possessed by Lucavi—such as Cardinal Delacroix and —were in on the plot.
